hook: A Miyapur single screen just got Disney's *premium-format* tag
hook_b: A Miyapur single screen just got Disney's *premium-format* tag
tldr: Sai Ranga 70MM in Miyapur became the first single-screen theatre in Telangana to get Disney's Infinity Vision certification.

beats.what: Infinity Vision is Disney's Premium Large Format certification programme in India.
beats.why: It recognises auditoriums that meet standards for screen size, projection and immersive sound.
beats.care: Single screens in the Telugu states face rising competition from multiplexes and OTT.

event.label: Sai Ranga 70MM gets Infinity Vision tag

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The tag needs a screen at least 45 feet wide, 2K-or-better laser projection, set brightness levels and Dolby Atmos or 7.1 sound.
